name: Backups
summary: Every backup ForkMesh keeps on this computer on one rail page, sorted onto shelves: rotating snapshots, kept ones, package data, what a restore moved aside and the fleet database. Label, verify, copy, restore or delete them.

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: List and read the backups in this desktop's data folder and the fleet backup folder
Keep, label, copy and delete desktop backups you choose; fleet backups stay read-only
Take a snapshot now and turn hourly snapshots on or off through the desktop
Ask the desktop to restore a snapshot you pick, which replaces your identity and restarts
Run tar or gzip to read a backup through and check it is intact

screenshots.alt: The Backups page: shelves on the left with counts and sizes, and the snapshots on the selected shelf with their labels, ages and the actions for the chosen one
